title: Ground station telemetry
description: One object per message on gsu/{station_id}/telemetry. Discriminated by `kind`. Unknown fields are ignored by the platform, and unknown kinds are dropped rather than erroring - so a new sensor can be added station-side before the platform renders it.

aircraft.description: The complete current picture, not a delta. An empty array means no contacts, which is different from sending nothing - sending nothing is what a failed receiver looks like.

icao.description: 24-bit address, hex. The identity the platform tracks a contact by.

latitude.description: Null until a position has been decoded; a Mode S response alone gives none.

track.description: Degrees true. Null if unknown - the console draws a dot rather than pointing it in an invented direction.

alert.description: Close and low enough to be worth flagging. The station decides, because the threshold belongs with the site.

wind_dir_deg.description: Direction the wind comes FROM - meteorological convention, the opposite of a movement vector. Getting this backwards is the classic wind-rose bug.

sky.description: Present weather, reported by the station rather than inferred by the console - so the icon can never contradict the numbers beside it.

rain_mm_today.description: Running total since local midnight, in the station's own timezone.

soc_pct.description: Battery state of charge. Recorded to history at one sample per minute.

runtime_h.description: Hours left at the current draw; null while charging.

freq_hz.description: Airband only. The console clamps to this range and so should the station.

noise_floor_db.description: Measured OUTSIDE the channel - see contract/README.md rule 3.

threshold_db.description: Squelch threshold currently applied, whether set by hand or by AUTO.

squelch_open.description: True whenever audio is flowing, including when held open by monitor.

auto_squelch.description: Reported by the station, not remembered by the console - the AUTO chip reflects hardware state rather than the last click.

monitor.description: Squelch defeated by an operator holding monitor.

gain.description: Tuner gain: "auto" or dB. Prefer a fixed value; the tuner AGC desenses near strong transmitters.

gains.description: Gains this hardware offers, so the console can list them rather than guess.

tx_capable.description: False on receive-only hardware. The console disables PTT from this.

on.description: What the hardware is actually doing, not what was last commanded. The console renders this and never assumes a command succeeded.
